outlet.name: ABC News (US)
outlet.summary: ABC News in the United States, the network's national and world file is leading with Appeals court hears arguments in Trump admin's voting suit against California; US Marine indicted in alleged Okinawa robbery homicide; 12 injured, including 6 children, in shooting near Florida university, police say.

items.headline: Appeals court hears arguments in Trump admin's voting suit against California
items.detail: A federal appeals court had a rare Sunday hearing in the Justice Department's voting lawsuit against California.

items.headline: US Marine indicted in alleged Okinawa robbery homicide
items.detail: A 20-year-old U.S. Marine stationed in Okinawa, Japan, has been indicted on charges murder and robbery.

items.headline: 12 injured, including 6 children, in shooting near Florida university, police say
items.detail: At least 11 of those injured had gunshot wounds, police said.

items.headline: WATCH: Halloween witches’ world record
items.detail: A total of 184 people set a world record, decked out in pointed hats and witches’ cloaks, 400 feet up on the Orlando Eye.

items.headline: WATCH: 2 brothers' Make-A-Wish visit to the Minnesota Vikings
items.detail: The Yang brothers got to visit the Minnesota Vikings for Aiden's Make-A-Wish after his brother, Ryan, became his lifesaving bone marrow donor while battling leukemia.
